title: Strength adjustments.
officialText:
Design values for untreated lumber and wood structural panels, as
specified in Section 2303.1, shall be adjusted for fire -retardant-treated wood. Adjustments to design
values shall be based on an approved method of investigation that takes into consideration the effects of the
anticipated temperature and humidity to which the fire-retardant-treated wood will be subjected, the type of
treatment and redrying procedures.
